name: Factcheck
text: Factcheck: Hold—your plan misses the *freshness* criterion by cherry-picking *old* sources. The EU AI Act final text was published 2024-05-21, but the *official consolidated text* (post-Council vote) dropped 2024-07-12—*that’s* the version to verify.
